lines.speaker: market_vendor
lines.text: Hull patches, shield capacitors, dubious warranties. Pick one problem and I can make it less obvious.

lines.speaker: market_vendor
lines.text: Hull is sealed. Do not ask what the patch used to be.

lines.speaker: market_vendor
lines.text: Shield bank is charged. If it hums in B-flat, turn it off for a minute.

lines.speaker: market_vendor
lines.text: Suit yourself. The dents will still be there when you come back.
